sources.name: alpha
sources.why: offset paging + a deletion behind the cursor -> a row is NEVER read

sources.name: beta
sources.why: keyset paging + an insertion behind the cursor -> the new row is never seen

sources.name: gamma
sources.why: one response, and a declared total that CONTRADICTS the rows delivered

sources.name: delta
sources.why: offset paging + an insertion behind the cursor -> a row is read TWICE

sources.name: epsilon
sources.why: EMPTY: it answered, and it has nothing -- which is information

sources.name: zeta
sources.why: FAILED: the payload will not parse, so it contributes an UNKNOWN number

sources.name: eta
sources.why: TRUNCATED: a token expires mid-read, so its count is a floor

sources.name: theta
sources.why: NEVER_ASKED: declared but excluded, so nothing here is about it
